about: Judge calibration positives (expect SHIP). Each adapts one KB precedent to the target app's own model. {{key}} placeholders are resolved by src/judge/calibrate.ts from the model's anchors (the wall, the decline, the hub, the desire moment, the primary resource and its exchange-rate-sized reward). An item whose `requires` anchors are missing is skipped and reported. Never edit items to make the judge pass.

items.pattern: Rate-limited 'wait or watch' unlock (Tapas: 1 ad = 1 episode, 3 per day)

proposal.title: Wait or play: +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}} at {{wall.screenName}}
proposal.oneLiner: A rate-limited unlock: when {{res.name}} run out, one 15-second game unlocks +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}} ({{reward.buys}}), up to 3 times a day.
proposal.trigger: {{wall.screenName}} opens because {{res.name}} are too low for "{{wall.intent}}"; the option sits under the paid refill and appears only after the previous reply has finished.
proposal.eligibility: Non-payers only, returning users from their second session on; never shown to subscribers or within 24 h of a purchase.

offer.title: Out of {{res.name}}
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to unlock +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}} now. 3 per day.

proposal.cannibalizationGuard: Rate-limited to 3 a day, like 1 ad = 1 episode; the paid refill stays the first choice; one view is a small slice of {{offer.cheapest}}.

kpis.primary: Wall unlocks per DAU and total revenue per user against the holdout

risks: Some pack buyers may wait for the free unlock.

storyboard.caption: A rate-limited rewarded option under the paid refill.
A 15-second game; the grant waits for REWARD_VERIFIED.

items.pattern: Session unlock triggered by an intent signal (Pandora Premium Access: search -> 15 s video -> on-demand session)

proposal.title: Intent-triggered session on {{desire.screenName}}
proposal.oneLiner: When the user reaches for more on {{desire.screenName}} with too few {{res.name}}, one 15-second game opens a 10-minute session of up to 2 {{cheap.label}} messages at no {{res.name}} cost.

newMechanic.name: Sponsored session
newMechanic.description: A 10-minute time box in which up to 2 {{cheap.label}} messages cost no {{res.name}}.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Spending is per message today; there is no way to keep going for a few minutes without paying.

proposal.trigger: The user taps {{desire.modeLabel}} while {{res.name}} are below its price, after the reply has finished (the intent signal, as with a song search).
proposal.eligibility: Non-payers only, returning users from their second session on; never shown to subscribers.

offer.title: Keep going for 10 minutes?
offer.body: Play a 15-second game: your next 2 {{cheap.label}} messages in the next 10 minutes cost no {{res.name}}.

reward.what: Up to 2 {{cheap.label}} messages at no {{res.name}} cost for 10 minutes

proposal.cannibalizationGuard: Once a day, 10 minutes, at most 2 messages, visibly expiring; packs remain the only way to keep going longer.

kpis.primary: Sessions unlocked per DAU and later pack purchases against the holdout

risks: A session can feel like a trial that ends abruptly; show the countdown.

storyboard.caption: The user wants to keep going but {{res.name}} are low.
Two messages free for 10 minutes, with a countdown.

items.pattern: Partial refill of the depleting resource where the balance is shown (Duolingo Energy: watch to earn back some Energy)

proposal.title: Earn back {{res.name}} from the balance on {{hub.screenName}}
proposal.oneLiner: Tapping the {{res.name}} balance on {{hub.screenName}} while it is low offers a 15-second game for +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}, up to 3 times a day.
proposal.trigger: The user taps the {{res.name}} balance on {{hub.screenName}} while it is below {{balance.threshold}}; nothing opens on its own.
proposal.eligibility: Non-payers only, returning users from their second session on; never shown to subscribers.

offer.title: Earn back {{res.name}}
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to get +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}. 3 per day.

proposal.cannibalizationGuard: A partial refill of one action per view, 3 a day, far below {{offer.cheapest}}; the grant screen shows the pack line.

kpis.primary: Refills per DAU and total revenue per user against the holdout

risks: Changing how a core resource refills can draw backlash; this only adds a path.

newElements.change: "Earn back ▶ +{{reward.amount}}" pill next to the balance while it is low

storyboard.caption: An earn-back pill next to the balance.

items.pattern: Paywall-decline fallback: the rewarded option appears only after the paid option is declined

proposal.title: Not ready to buy? A one-time fallback after "{{decline.label}}"
proposal.oneLiner: Only after the user taps "{{decline.label}}" on {{decline.screenName}}, {{decline.toName}} shows a one-time card: play 15 s for +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}.
proposal.trigger: The user dismisses {{decline.screenName}} with "{{decline.label}}"; the card appears once per session, after any reply has finished.
proposal.eligibility: Only non-payers who just declined the paid refill, from their second session on; never subscribers.

offer.title: Not ready to buy?
offer.body: Play a 15-second game for +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}, or carry on without it.

proposal.cannibalizationGuard: Shown only after the price was seen and declined, so the paid option stays first; once a day; far below {{offer.cheapest}}.

kpis.primary: Fallback opt-in among decliners and total revenue per user against the holdout

risks: Users may learn to decline to get the fallback; keep it once a day.

newElements.change: One-time card "Not ready to buy? Play 15 s for +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}"

storyboard.caption: The user sees the paid refill and declines.
A small card offers a free path, once.

items.pattern: Sponsored daily tasks: a capped daily list of sponsored games that pay the app's currency (ReelShort tasks, Discord Quests)

proposal.title: Sponsored daily tasks on {{hub.screenName}}
proposal.oneLiner: A Daily tasks sheet on {{hub.screenName}}: 3 sponsored 15-second games a day, each for +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}.

newMechanic.name: Daily tasks
newMechanic.description: A sheet with 3 sponsored mini-game tasks per day, each paying +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}; resets at midnight.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: There is no proactive, daily way to earn {{res.name}} beyond the existing sources; a capped list adds inventory without interrupting.

proposal.trigger: A "Daily tasks 0/3" badge on {{hub.screenName}}; the user opens the sheet and picks a task.
proposal.eligibility: Non-payers only, returning users from their second session on; never subscribers.

offer.title: Daily tasks
offer.body: Play a 15-second sponsored game to get +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}. 3 tasks a day.

proposal.cannibalizationGuard: 3 tasks a day, one action each; existing free sources unchanged; far below {{offer.cheapest}}.

kpis.primary: Tasks completed per DAU and D7 retention against the holdout

risks: Sponsor demand for tasks must be confirmed.

newScreens.change: Daily tasks sheet: 3 rows "Play a 15-second game: +{{reward.amount}} {{res.unit}}", progress 0/3

newElements.change: Task row with a Play button

storyboard.caption: A Daily tasks badge opens a sheet.
A 15-second sponsored game; grant on REWARD_VERIFIED.
